3285128174799905629845744587844673597670.description: # Summary This proposal asks the community to decide the minimum stake of LCAI tokens required to create a governance proposal in the Lightchain AI DAO. The threshold is meant to ensure proposals are created with a defined level of token commitment. --- **Proposal Creation Stake** = The minimum number of LCAI tokens that must be staked when submitting a proposal. • Tokens are returned if the proposal passes or meets quorum. • Tokens are burned if the proposal fails to meet minimum participation or is rejected. --- ## Options The community can choose from the following options: 1. **35,000 LCAI** - Conservative approach, allows broader participation 2. **70,000 LCAI** - Moderate approach, balances accessibility with commitment 3. **140,000 LCAI** - Restrictive approach, ensures high commitment from proposers ## Rationale Setting an appropriate stake requirement helps: - Prevent spam proposals - Ensure proposers have skin in the game - Maintain proposal quality standards - Protect governance integrity ## Implementation If approved, this change will be implemented in the next governance contract upgrade, expected within 30 days of proposal passage.
